description: This file defines interfaces for application notifications within the WPEFramework, including subscription, emission, and cleanup of notifications, as well as handling notification events.

classes.name: IAppNotifications
classes.description: Interface for managing application notifications, including subscribing, emitting, and cleaning up notifications.

classes.name: IAppNotificationHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling app notification events and emit callbacks.

classes.name: IEmitter
classes.description: Interface for emitting notification events to applications.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Register or unregister for Firebolt subscription requests based on the provided context, module, and event.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Dispatch an event with payload to all or specific applications based on appId.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleanup notification contexts associated with a specific connectionId and origin.

methods.name: HandleAppEventNotifier
methods.description: Handle expectations for app event notifications, setting up emit callbacks for specific events.

methods.name: Emit
methods.description: Dispatch an event for a specific app or all apps via the emit callback interface.
